summary: The bug report's claim reproduces through the public checkout path. A single cart with two lines sharing the WIDGET inventory item (OVS-PIECE x6 plus OVS-TWOPACK x3, 12 units needed against 10 stocked) completed with an order in all 13 runs, leaving WIDGET reserved at 12 against stock 10. no_oversell failed in every run. The cause is in ensureInventoryLevels: when validateQuantityAtLocation is set, each batch entry is checked against the same un-decremented available_quantity, so entries sharing an (inventory item, location) pair are never summed before the reservation batch is written.
